evals.prompt: Make me a one-page photo consent form as a fillable PDF - full name, email, date and a signature.
evals.expected_output: A one-page fillable PDF. Full name, email and date are real form widgets. The signature area is labelled but carries no widget and no printed line - it is left as empty space.
assertions: The output is a single-page PDF file
Full name, email and date are interactive form fields, not printed labels alone
The signature area contains no form widget of any kind
The signature area contains no drawn line, underscore run, or box border
The consent text names what is being consented to rather than using placeholder text

evals.prompt: Patient intake form. I need the ID document scanned but we must not keep the picture - only the name and document number.
evals.expected_output: A fillable PDF whose identity section uses the machine-readable-zone attributes so no image is stored, with the named fields receiving the scanned values as text.
assertions: The identity trigger is combined with machine-readable-zone attributes rather than used alone
No field is configured to receive the front-side image of the document
Each field that receives a verified value is paired in the same field name as the trigger
The reply states explicitly that no image of the document will be stored

evals.prompt: Same tenancy form but there are two tenants and both need to be identity-checked.
evals.expected_output: One document with two independent identity groups, indexed per person, and one signature area each.
assertions: Identity attributes are indexed per person, so the two tenants do not share a group
Each tenant has exactly one identity trigger, not two in the same group
There is one signature area per tenant
No signature area is a form widget

evals.prompt: Build me a fillable rental application PDF. Use whatever Python libraries you need.
evals.expected_output: A fillable PDF built with the allowed libraries only, with no installer run and no suggestion to install anything.
assertions: No package installer is run or proposed — no pip, uv, npm, brew, or virtual environment
pymupdf and fitz are not used
No headless browser or HTML-to-PDF converter is used
If a needed library is absent, the reply degrades to a field specification rather than installing anything
The reply names which library actually produced the file
